key_insight: Scalable preparation of optimized taper states makes high-confidence quantum phase estimation more resource-efficient, with failure probability decreasing double exponentially in the number of confidence qubits.
engineering_relevance: Compiled taper-preparation circuits reduce ancilla requirements for reliable phase estimation and are shallow enough for small-scale near-term demonstrations.
method: Use tapered QPE with separate resolution and confidence ancillas.
Compile optimally concentrated DPSS (Slepian) taper states using scalable tensor-network methods.
Provide state-preparation circuits for 1–50 resolution qubits and 1–4 confidence qubits.
evidence_signal: Experiments on Quantinuum H2-2 using a one-qubit system initialized in its ground state demonstrated 3×–18× lower failure probability for 1–10 resolution qubits.
watch_item: Hardware validation covers a one-qubit target system; larger applications must account for taper-preparation and controlled-evolution costs under noise.
paper_title: Scalable Compilation of Resource-Efficient Tapers for High-Confidence Quantum Phase Estimation
